fact.en: Lena, 23:02: "Don't trust the me who's talking."

limit.en: A voice alone doesn't verify who sent it.
limit.zh: 单靠声音不能确认身份。

fact.en: The center feed plays the same cup push twice. Same motion, same sound.
fact.zh: 中心转播把同一个推杯动作播了两遍，动作和声音完全相同。

limit.en: It shows the feed isn't live. Not who did it.
limit.zh: 只能说明转播不是实时的，不能说明是谁干的。

fact.en: Lena did a move you just made up, on the direct line. The center feed did not.
fact.zh: 你临时提的动作，Lena 在直连上做到了；中心转播没有回应。

limit.en: This line is live. It doesn't prove she's hiding nothing.
limit.zh: 说明这条线是实时的，不说明她没有隐瞒。

fact.en: At midnight, gas suppression runs on B2 and B3. The doors seal. It was scheduled tonight, from an operations account.
fact.zh: 午夜，B2、B3 释放灭火气体，门会封死。这个“测试”是今晚才排的，来自运维账号。

limit.en: It could still be routine. It does not name who booked it.
limit.zh: 也可能只是例行，没有写是谁排的。

fact.en: On your screen: the center feed's source is CLIP-A17, recorded at last night's handover. Not camera B2-03.
fact.zh: 你屏幕上的日志：中心转播来源是素材 CLIP-A17，昨晚交班时录的，不是 B2-03 摄像头。

limit.en: Shows what played. Not who pressed play.
limit.zh: 说明播的是什么，不说明谁按的播放。

fact.en: 23:17 manual lockdown, B2. User shown: L-HART.
fact.zh: 23:17，B2 手动闭锁，显示工号 L-HART（Lena 自己）。

limit.en: A display name is not the person who did it.
limit.zh: 显示名不等于实际操作人。

fact.en: Full entry: session MIG-0412, delegated. Started from an operations account.
fact.zh: 完整条目：会话 MIG-0412，委托会话，由运维账号发起。

limit.en: A photo of a screen, not the raw log. It does not name a person.
limit.zh: 是屏幕照片，不是底层日志，也没有写是哪个人。

fact.en: Adrian Voss, head of operations: "The relay only streams live. It can't replay anything." He asked you to switch off auto-backup.
fact.zh: 运维负责人 Adrian Voss 说：“转播只能直播，不能回放。”并要你关掉自动备份。

limit.en: A claim, until something contradicts it.
limit.zh: 在有矛盾证据之前，这只是一个说法。

fact.en: The man in the coverall opened the stair door with a spare key and let Lena through.
fact.zh: 穿工装的男人用备用钥匙打开楼梯门，让 Lena 过去。

limit.en: He helped once. That doesn't explain why he's here.
limit.zh: 他帮了一次，不说明他为什么在这里。

fact.en: Lena admits she already copied the original record to a USB stick. She kept it from you.
fact.zh: Lena 承认她已把原始记录复制到 U 盘，一直瞒着你。

limit.en: A copy needs a witness or a second source.
limit.zh: 副本还需要证人或第二来源。

fact.en: Six years ago, 23:17: B3 was locked under Tom Reyes's own ID. Then fire. The log says the valve opened. It is still closed. There are scratches on the inside of the door.
fact.zh: 六年前 23:17：B3 被闭锁，显示 Tom Reyes 自己的工号。然后起火。日志写阀门已打开，阀门至今是关的。门内侧有抓痕。

limit.en: Same time, same trick as tonight. Not yet who did it.
limit.zh: 和今晚同一时间、同一手法，但还不能说明是谁。

fact.en: Hollis saw the valve closed that night and saw the log entry change. He stayed silent for six years.
fact.zh: Hollis 当晚看到阀门是关的，也看到日志后来被改。他沉默了六年。

limit.en: One witness. He has to be willing to say it.
limit.zh: 只是一个证人，他得愿意说出来。

fact.en: Your new move appeared only on the direct line. The relay kept showing the old reaction, and Voss answered to the old one.
fact.zh: 你设计的新动作只出现在直连上；转播继续放旧反应，Voss 按旧反应回答了你。

limit.en: Shows he is watching the relay, and believes it.
limit.zh: 说明他在看转播，并且相信它。

fact.en: CLIP-A17, session MIG-0412 and the midnight test were all started from console C-2, on Adrian Voss's badge.
fact.zh: CLIP-A17、会话 MIG-0412 和午夜测试，都从控制台 C-2 发起，用的是 Adrian Voss 的工卡。

limit.en: This is the chain. It names him.
limit.zh: 这是完整操作链，指向他本人。

fact.en: 23:48: the center feed switched. "Lena" now says she locked the doors herself. The cuts jump. The light changes mid-sentence.
fact.zh: 23:48，中心转播换了内容：“Lena”说门是她自己锁的。画面在跳，同一句话里光线都变了。

limit.en: Looks spliced. The whole building is watching it anyway.
limit.zh: 像是拼的。可全楼看到的就是这个。

q.en: Is this really her, right now?
q.zh: 屏幕上这个人，是现在的她吗？

q.en: Who is playing the fake feed?

tip.en: You don't know me. Lena Hart is locked in on B2 at Meridian.
tip.zh: 你不认识我。Lena Hart 被锁在 Meridian 地下二层。

tip.en: Six years ago tonight, 23:17, a man named Tom Reyes was locked in one floor below her. He never came out. They called it an accident.
tip.zh: 六年前的今晚 23:17，她楼下那层锁死了一个人，Tom Reyes。他没出来。对外说是事故。

tip.en: At 00:00 the gas system fires on her floor. The PA will call it a test. The doors will seal.
tip.zh: 今晚 00:00，她那层会放灭火气体。广播会说是测试。门会封死。

tip.en: She doesn't know any of this. The feed says she's fine. That was recorded last night.
tip.zh: 这些她都不知道。转播里她说自己没事，那是昨晚录的。

tip.en: She will call you. Get her out. Bring proof, or it happens again.
tip.zh: 她马上会打给你。把她带出来，带上证据，不然这事还会再来一次。

timeline.zh: 转播换内容：把罪名放到 Lena 头上
timeline.en: The feed changes: Lena takes the blame

timeline.zh: 通风关闭，B2、B3 开始封层
timeline.en: Vents shut. B2 and B3 begin sealing
Gas fires on B2 and B3. Doors seal

text.zh: 00:00，楼下空放了一场气。U 盘和控制台记录已经发出去，Voss 的工卡挂在每一条记录上。六年前的那扇门，今晚第一次有人替他打开。
text.en: 00:00. The gas fired on empty floors. The stick and the console trail are already out, with Voss's badge on every line. Six years late, someone opened Tom's door.

text.zh: 00:00，她在雨里活着。可转播一直在放她的“认罪”，每一扇门的记录都写着她的工号。你们手里的东西，还指不到他。
text.en: 00:00. She is alive in the rain. But the feed keeps playing her confession, and every lock log shows her ID. What you have can't reach him.

text.zh: 00:00，门封死了。三分钟后她给你打了视频，说她没事，让你删掉东西。她答不出蓝伞。同一个时间、同一个手法，这是第二个人。
text.en: 00:00. The doors sealed. Three minutes later she video-called: fine, go home, delete it. She couldn't answer blue umbrella. Same time, same trick. The second person.

text.zh: 23:42 侧门落锁，她还在放映室。之后的十八分钟，你们什么都做不了。00:00，转播里的她还在说没事。
text.en: 23:42. The side door locked with her still inside. For eighteen minutes there was nothing left to do. At 00:00 the feed still said she's fine.

text.zh: 摄像头、错误的密码、不该说的话，Voss 一路都看着。他站到她身后，问了你那句话：你存了吗？通话断了。
text.en: The cameras, the wrong code, the wrong words. Voss watched all of it. He stood behind her and asked you: did you save it? The call ended.

text.zh: 你信了那个声音。他说了谢谢，很礼貌。证据没了，门没开。00:00，转播里的她还在说没事。
text.en: You trusted the voice. He said thank you, very politely. The proof is gone. The doors stayed shut. At 00:00 the feed still said she's fine.
